title: Step Response of an RC Circuit and Decomposition into Transient and Steady-State Components
expert_review: A classic problem illustrating the time-domain response of first-order circuits using Laplace methods.
learning_objectives: Compute the step response of a first-order system
Use Laplace transforms to solve circuit response problems
Separate transient and steady-state components of a response
Interpret RC circuit dynamics in the time domain
